facts.fact: Central Equatoria State government launched a Digital Land Registry for Juba and surroundings on 11 August 2023, with the governor saying it would be extended to Yei, Terekeka, possibly Kajo-Keji and Kaya; the article does not say transactions are processed on it.

systems.owner: Central Equatoria State Ministry of Land, Housing and Public Utilities

note: States only a plan: the commissioner directed engineers to design a single land system; nothing built or in service.

facts.fact: FAO issued a request for proposal on 23 September 2025, closing 30 October 2025, for consultancy services to develop a Land Information System for South Sudan.
facts.system: Land Information System (LIS) for South Sudan
